mapper.delete: DELETE FROM OFT_PRODUCT_PRICE_MATCH WHERE PRODUCT_NO IN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO FROM OFT_PRODUCT WHERE SALE_STATUS = 'SELLING' )
mapper.select: WITH latest_snapshot AS ( SELECT SNAPSHOT_NO, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, MARKET_TYPE, UNIT, AVG_PRICE, SNAPSHOT_DATE FROM ( SELECT ps.SNAPSHOT_NO, ps.ITEM_CODE, ps.ITEM_NAME, ps.MARKET_TYPE, ps.UNIT, ps.AVG_PRICE, ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ps.ITEM_CODE, ps.MARKET_TYPE ORDER BY ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE DESC, ps.SNAPSHOT_NO DESC ) AS rn FROM OFT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT ps ) WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT pcm.MAP_NO AS mapNo, p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.UNIT AS productUnit, p.PACKAGE_WEIGHT AS packageWeight, p.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, p.SALE_STATUS AS saleStatus, pcm.MARKET_TYPE AS marketType, pcm.ITEM_CATEGORY_CODE AS itemCategoryCode, pcm.ITEM_CODE AS itemCode, pcm.KIND_CODE AS kindCode, pcm.PRODUCT_RANK_CODE AS productRankCode, pcm.COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, pcm.CONVERT_KG_YN AS convertKgYn, pcm.ITEM_NAME_HINT AS itemNameHint, pcm.UNIT_HINT AS unitHint, ls.SNAPSHOT_NO AS snapshotNo, ls.ITEM_CODE AS snapshotItemCode, ls.ITEM_NAME AS snapshotItemName, ls.UNIT AS snapshotUnit, ls.AVG_PRICE AS avgPrice, TO_CHAR(ls.SNAPSHOT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS snapshotDate FROM OFT_PRODUCT_PRICE_CODE_MAP pcm JOIN OFT_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_NO = pcm.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON ls.MARKET_TYPE = pcm.MARKET_TYPE AND ls.ITEM_CODE = pcm.MARKET_TYPE || '_' || pcm.ITEM_CATEGORY_CODE || '_' || pcm.ITEM_CODE || '_' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(pcm.KIND_CODE), '|', '-'), ',', '-'), ' ', '') || '_' || pcm.PRODUCT_RANK_CODE || '_' || pcm.COUNTRY_CODE || '_' || pcm.CONVERT_KG_YN WHERE pcm.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND p.SALE_STATUS = 'SELLING' ORDER BY p.PRODUCT_NO ASC, pcm.MAP_NO ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_PRODUCT_PRICE_MATCH ( PRODUCT_NO, SNAPSHOT_NO, COMPARED_PRICE, PRICE_GAP, SAVING_RATE, BADGE_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{snapshotNo}, #{comparedPrice}, #{priceGap}, #{savingRate}, #{badgeType} )
